data.body: Final debug report: Problem — ordinary broad test subprocess environment mappings could render inherited credential values in pytest long tracebacks when process startup failed. Proven root cause — 103 test-local/helper sites constructed ordinary dict representations from os.environ; pytest/stdlib exception rendering serialized those mappings. Proof — a real startup-failure probe with a first-position sentinel yielded four disclosures under long traceback and zero under short traceback; the redacted mapping preserved exact child values, while rewrapping it as dict restored the disclosure. Test — tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py was observed RED before repair, GREEN after repair, and returned RED under raw-constructor and boundary-unwrapping mutations. Fix — all 103 sites now use a mutable representation-safe environment mapping; the AST policy guard rejects raw broad construction and unsafe unwrapping. Scope and safety — mapping semantics, key/value/order, and intentional ambient propagation are preserved; no production path or dependency changed; no test was weakened. Siblings — the full AST census was repaired; seven previously separate fixture sites were subsequently repaired and the temporary exclusions removed. Residual risk — explicit --showlocals may expose stdlib env_list bytes and remains accepted as outside this default-long traceback contract. Replication — focused suite passed 25 tests; supported full inventory passed 14,019 tests with only unrelated failures separately ticketed; Gerrit 1866 then passed LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and merged as 48d4a4d4a984cca201bbbb6874e4e8500a729d3a.
